firebase._help: Customer accounts + orders database. Paste the Firebase web app config here (public identifiers, not secrets). See README > Customer accounts. Admin/staff emails live in src/data/admins.json (private, not uploaded to GitHub).
firebase._help_sms: true = new accounts must verify their mobile by SMS (needs the Firebase Blaze plan). false = mobile saved without SMS (still unique per account).

forms._help: Leave endpoint empty to send orders/messages by opening the customer's email app (to the email above). To receive them directly, create a free form at https://web3forms.com or https://formspree.io and paste the URL/key here.
